Overview

Storybase is the all-in-one platform for authors to publish their books and reach readers.

1
Write the book

We help your team plan how each author gets their story down, on paper or in a recorded interview. Then our AI writing tool turns it into a manuscript.

03 / 09
Step 1 of 3

Write the book

Each book needs a manuscript of at least 10,000 words.

Plan
We work with your team on the questions each author answers.
Write
The author writes their story on paper, or tells it in a recorded interview after release.
Draft
Our AI writing tool turns the pages or interview into a first draft.
Edit
The author reads the draft and makes any changes.
One-time $2,000 setup
Publishing proposal for Team Impact
04 / 09
Step 2 of 3

Publish the book

Storybase's publisher tools do this automatically.

Proofread
Storybase checks the manuscript for spelling and grammar.
Cover
Use our AI cover creation tool, or work with your own designer to create the book's cover.
Ebook and print
Readers can buy the ebook or the print book. Print copies are made to order, so there's no inventory.
Audiobook
An AI voice narrates the book. The author can listen to it before it goes live.
Included in $350 a month, with one audiobook a month

Launch the book

Every author gets Storybase Pro, our top plan for authors.

For each author
  • A web page to sell their book
  • Free ebook and audiobook copies to share with anyone

For Team Impact
  • All your books and readers in one account
  • A welcome email to each new reader that shares the vision of Team Impact
  • Invite readers to give, volunteer, or get involved in your mission
Included in $350 a month

Pricing

$350
a month, cancel any time
+ $2,000 one-time setup
  • Storybase Pro for every author
